thread:
michelle: quick design review for playground chat UI — focusing on streaming display, stop/regenerate affordances, token counter location (compact vs wide), and prompt library insert behavior. sharing two slim mocks. please drop accessibility and copy nits.

sam: big +1. make stop control obvious while streaming. users need a clear escape. :eyes:

jorge: agree but compact view is tight. propose icon-only stop that expands on hover/focus.

alex: two patterns: inline icon cluster vs persistent footer toolbar. inline keeps context; footer is more discoverable. compact token counter could be an icon badge that reveals count on tap.

katie: accessibility checklist: stop must be in tab order immediately after message; aria-label="Stop streaming response"; announce streaming start/stop via live region; prompt library dialog must trap focus (role=dialog, aria-modal=true) and support Ctrl/Cmd+K.

michelle: microcopy suggestions: "Stop streaming", "Regenerate response", "Retry" (retry = same request), prompt actions: "Insert and edit" / "Insert & send". token label: "tokens (response)".

sam: telemetry: record which stop control is used and rate of insert+send. A/B test placements.

jorge: contrast nit: token badge in dark theme needs higher contrast for small text.

figma-bot: New comment on frame "Playground/Stream compact v2": https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/playground-stream-compact

michelle: decisions: widescreen = footer toolbar; compact = inline icon-only stop + token badge with reveal. owners: alex update mocks, jorge contrast pass, katie write ARIA spec + keyboard flow, sam add telemetry. scheduling 30m sync tomorrow. thanks! :tada:
